1984 Plan.

a minimal investment from consumers in order to produce Serious trial f
among competitive smokers. A $.25 on pack coupon will further streng- 5
then trial, increasing the probability of usage upgrading/conversion, i
Pay City, MY (TA 64) and Grand Rapids, MI (TA 65) are the designated :

respectively and 2.1% of national VICZROY sales. }

(150:f4 units) share to achieve a one year pavback from 5.4.4

stores, requiring minimal consumer investment. 7

to the consumer. This suggested 10's pack price is 45% of a !
20's pack selling price. This price level will cover 7 {
variable manufacturing costs and applicable state tax while o
. allowing for maintenance of distributor and retailer mar- fon]
gins comparable toa 20's pack. -
